name: Mennet Carkad
summary: In the Undercity, Marion Call sends you to report to Mennet Carkad. Deep in the Rogues' Quarter, he tests promising operatives for the Deathstalkers.

sections.title: A Summons from the Shadows
sections.body: Marion Call brings you a summons from Mennet Carkad. In the Undercity, higher leaders notice covert operatives, and Marion carries word when a scout or assassin is called to report. The Forsaken's intelligence arm is feared for its deadly work. Ignoring its orders is no real choice.

sections.title: Joining the Deathstalkers
sections.body: Mennet Carkad waits in the Rogues' Quarter, where he watches recruits and judges their readiness. Those who answer his call face tests for entry into the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's feared arm of espionage and assassination. To serve the Dark Lady from the shadows, obedience comes first.

faq.answer: Mennet Carkad trains rogues and oversees the Deathstalkers in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter. He watches promising covert agents and assigns important work for the Forsaken leadership.

faq.q: What happens if someone ignores Mennet Carkad's summons?
aliases: what happens if you ignore summons
faq.answer: Marion Call warns you not to ask what happened to those who ignored Carkad's call. She does not explain their exact fate.

The Deathstalkers are an elite order of rogues, spies, and assassins who serve the Forsaken. From the Undercity's shadows, they eliminate high-value targets, gather intelligence, and defend Lordaeron from enemies such as the Scarlet Crusade and the Scourge.

faq.q: Where can I find Mennet Carkad?
faq.answer: You can find Mennet Carkad in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter, among covert operatives, trainers, and shadowcraft supplies.

faq.q: Who gives the quest to seek out Mennet Carkad?
faq.answer: Marion Call sends you to find Mennet Carkad from Brill's Gallows' End Tavern. She has noticed your growing skills and warns that Carkad expects prompt obedience.

faq.q: What comes after reporting to Mennet Carkad?
faq.answer: Reporting to Mennet Carkad leads directly into service with the Deathstalkers. Your first duties are meant to prove your cunning and loyalty to the Forsaken cause.

angles.text: As a rogue, you answer a summons that marks your passage from unproven cutpurse to recognized Deathstalker asset, part of the Forsaken's elite shadow network.
As an undead, you know the Deathstalkers help keep the Forsaken alive. They hunt Scarlet zealots and Scourge remnants, and protect Queen Sylvanas from hidden threats.
